report_name: Ransomware Attacks Climb 33% as AI Accelerates Tool Development

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: A dominant ransomware group that claimed 279 victims in Q2 2026, though its overall market share is shrinking due to the rise of new groups.

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen
threat_actors.description: A new ransomware group that became the second most active in Q2 2026 with 269 victims. An internal leak confirmed the group used AI coding assistants to build its management panel in just three days, demonstrating AI's role in accelerating tool development.

threat_actors.name: KryBit
threat_actors.description: A newer ransomware group mentioned as part of a trend of targeting organizations outside the United States.

threat_actors.name: SafePay
threat_actors.description: A newer ransomware group mentioned as part of a trend of targeting organizations outside the United States.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The core technique of all ransomware operations, used to encrypt victim data to extort payment.

attack_patterns.name: Develop Capabilities
attack_patterns.description: Threat actors are using AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT to rapidly develop and refine malicious tools, such as ransomware management panels and encryption modules.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: A primary initial access vector for ransomware groups, with the time between vulnerability disclosure and exploit weaponization shrinking, partly due to AI assistance.

attack_patterns.name: Web Protocols
attack_patterns.description: Used for data exfiltration to data leak sites as part of the double-extortion ransomware model.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware precursors often involve deleting volume shadow copies using tools like vssadmin to prevent easy system recovery.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: Adversaries use tools like Mimikatz to dump credentials from memory, such as from the LSASS process, to facilitate lateral movement.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: Adversaries use remote services like PsExec, RDP, and WMI for lateral movement within a compromised network.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
attack_patterns.description: Suspicious PowerShell commands are used for downloading payloads from untrusted sources and disabling security features.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: The ransomware used by the Qilin threat actor group in their double-extortion attacks.

tools.name: AI coding assistants
tools.description: Used by threat actors like 'The Gentlemen' to accelerate the development of malicious tools, such as ransomware management panels, encryption modules, and phishing lures.

tools.name: Mimikatz
tools.description: A credential dumping tool used by ransomware actors to access credentials from LSASS process memory.

tools.name: PsExec
tools.description: A legitimate remote administration tool abused by ransomware actors for lateral movement between systems.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: A Windows command-line utility abused by ransomware to delete volume shadow copies, hindering system recovery.

identities.description: One of the most impacted industries by ransomware attacks in Q2 2026.

identities.description: One of the most impacted industries by ransomware attacks in Q2 2026.

infrastructure.name: Data Leak Sites
infrastructure.description: Used by ransomware groups to publicly post exfiltrated victim data as part of the double-extortion model.

indicators.name: Ransomware-Related Backup Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware-Related Backup Deletion
id: 2a8b3c4d-e5f6-4a90-8bcd-ef1234567890
status: experimental
description: Detects commands used by ransomware to delete volume shadow copies or backup catalogs to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/reports/check-point-ransomware-report-signals-rising-ai-use-faster-exploit-weaponization-widening-threat-landscape/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-17
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_vss:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  selection_wbadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'catalog'
  condition: 1 of them
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin or wbadmin to delete backups, a common precursor to ransomware deployment.

indicators.name: Suspicious PowerShell Download Activity
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Download Activity
id: 3b9c4d5e-f6a7-4891-8cde-f12345678901
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell commands used to download files from untrusted sources, a common precursor to ransomware execution.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/reports/check-point-ransomware-report-signals-rising-ai-use-faster-exploit-weaponization-widening-threat-landscape/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-17
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'IWR'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects PowerShell commands involving `IWR` or `Net.WebClient`, which are often used to download malicious payloads.
